subject: Basic Technology
sourceFile: Copy of Basic Science & Tech BECE Syllabus - syllabusNG.txt
examFormat: The BECE Basic Science and Technology syllabus aims to help candidates gain a fundamental understanding of science and technology, apply scientific and technological knowledge to address modern societal needs, and be equipped with essential knowledge for further studies in science and technology. Basic Science and Technology is examined in four compulsory papers (I–IV). Basic Technology is examined in Paper II, which has 60 multiple-choice questions covering Basic Technology and Computer Studies with an allocated time of sixty minutes, and in Paper IV, which consists of three required Technical Drawing (practical) problems based on basic geometric constructions, to be done in 45 minutes.
excluded: Syllabus.ng marketing ("About us", "About BECE"), eligibility, registration, grading table, table of contents and the FAQ chapter were left out. The Basic Science, Physical and Health Education and Computer Studies themes of the same file are in their own subject files. Topic IV "Processing of" (timber, metals, clay and glass, plastics and rubber) was split into four topics, one per material, following its four content groups.
recommendedTexts: NERDC Basic Technology for Junior Secondary Schools (UBE edition) — G. N. Nneji, E. J. Okon, V. C. Nwachukwu, N. A. David et al. (BHS Book Malaysia, Learn Africa and NERDC)

topics.content: Sub-theme: Materials and processing. Wood: furniture, building construction, handles of implements. Metals: household utensils, vehicle and ship parts. Brass: decorations, ammunition. Bronze: carving, statues, ornaments. Ceramics: tiles, household utensils. Rubber: tyres and tubes, footwear. Plastic: plastic buckets and bottles.
